mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox_event (consumer_name, event_id, event_key, aggregate_id, payload_hash, status) VALUES (#{consumerName}, #{eventId}, #{eventKey}, #{aggregateId}, #{payloadHash}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE duplicate_count = duplicate_count + 1, last_received_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT consumer_name, event_id, event_key, aggregate_id, payload_hash, status, duplicate_count, first_received_time, last_received_time, processed_time FROM inbox_event WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inbox_event SET status = 1, processed_time = NOW(), last_received_time = NOW() WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 0
